resources.string: Your saved profile on your devices: vocabulary, progress, records and settings. Learning works offline.
Firebase is not configured for this build yet. Your local data remains available as usual.
Sign-in is optional. Without an account, data stays on this device.
Sync did not finish. Changes are saved on this device. Check your connection and Firebase configuration, then retry.
This vocabulary is linked to another Google account. Sign in to the original account: data will not be sent to another user.

Your saved profile will be sent to Firebase: folders, decks, cards, trash, review schedule and history, the last review undo, Match records, languages, random direction and reminder preferences. It will be merged with the selected account on other devices. Independently created cards remain separate.

Concurrent changes are resolved by version; Match keeps the best time. Android permissions and installed voices are not transferred. Learning works offline.

This profile will be linked to one account: use the same account after signing out. Replacing a linked vocabulary from a JSON backup is disabled.

Your vocabulary, progress, records and settings will stay on this device. New changes will be stored locally until you sign in to the same account again. Data already uploaded will remain in the cloud.
JSON restore is disabled for a vocabulary linked to Google to protect cloud data from accidental replacement.
